notes: Landing from SfMJtsB5-Ds only at/after 5:10, sped up (Marvin rule). All other clips from the 10 Nov high-quality shortlist. TOMTOM limited to one video because of the 28% creator cap. Ranges are plans; clip_qc and the planner must still reject near-still, dark, or mismatched seconds. Files are release assets, not git. JMC3VLiM3ME range clips carry a digitally silent audio track (-91 dB), so audio=false (checked 10 Nov). 10 Nov v6 preview review: q9_rZmj1kSk audio banned (SFX); reversed ranges and the handheld walk banned; subject keys added so a place is shown in one block, never returned to. 10 Nov full cut: added range clips from the shortlist (TOMTOM jwnx/upG/qCGY, Boone, Aruba illustrated YMIq, Nik K 66AD/gI-qo) and sharp v5-library sources re-checked CC BY today (Regilio Jadi 4K re-download cropped to remove burned-in caption/watermark, Think Travel, NickWorldView, Daniel Mosquera, Thore, MrZona007, AlongForTheJourney).
